decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-0316e25d4611] names the subject: the `default` block of the runtime overrides config file, added in 2.9. It says the block was removed and replaced by a top-level `operational_config` in the standard Loki config, where runtime-config defaults now go. For the open applicability aspect, it gives a concrete condition: only environments that run Loki with a runtime config file and had populated the `default` block are exposed. An engineer could write that as a declarative condition, even though P1 judged the file contents not yet visible as a typed input.
